rca of the issue: test_email_creator failure RCA: Resend API logs show 'You have reached your daily email sending quota.' on multiple TEST_*@example.com sends. Root cause is the shared dev account hitting daily limit due to repeated iter1+iter2+iter3+iter4 test runs each sending real emails. Mitigation: (a) wait 24h for quota reset, OR (b) mock the resend.Emails.send call in pytest fixtures, OR (c) make the test treat sent=false as acceptable when error contains 'quota'. Not a product bug.
